faq.title: FAQS
faq.intro: The questions we get asked most — about materials, timelines, pricing and how a project actually runs from kickoff to final renders.
faq.askCopy: Still not sure about something? Tell us about the project and we'll come back with specifics.

start.q: What do we need to start a project?
start.p1: We begin with your 3D-model or drawings and a brief describing the mood, materials, and goals of your project. Using our structured onboarding system, our team refines your model and translates all inputs into high-end visuals.
start.linkTail: to get the full list of needed materials.
start.note: *(A detailed PDF guide with all requirements will be downloaded automatically)

workflow.intro: Each project goes through the following key stages:

steps.title: Discovery Stage
steps.desc: The client provides all necessary input materials. At this stage, we also prepare a cost estimate and a project timeline.

steps.title: Modeling & Optimization
steps.desc: We create or refine the 3D model based on all provided drawings and references, ensuring accuracy and efficiency for the visualization process.

steps.title: Cameras & Atmosphere Setup
steps.desc: We produce greyscale renderings to define and approve the best camera angles and overall atmosphere for your project.

steps.title: Color Previews
steps.desc: The client receives fully textured and colored renders with the selected views and atmosphere. We collect all feedback at this stage and prepare the images for final rendering.

steps.title: Final High-End Images
steps.desc: The client receives high-resolution final visualizations ready for presentations, marketing, and publications.

duration.q: How long does a project take?
paragraphs: The project timeline is always individual and depends on its complexity, goals, scale, input quality, response speed, and many other factors.
Smaller projects usually take around 7 working days, although the first drafts are typically delivered within the first few days after kickoff.

We understand that deadlines are often tight, so we organize our team efficiently to deliver as quickly as possible while keeping the entire process transparent and well-communicated with daily updates.
Before starting, every client receives a preliminary schedule outlining all key stages and we strictly follow it throughout the collaboration.

Our pricing depends on the project type (exterior or interior visualizations, animations, 360° tours, etc.), its goals, scale, and deadlines. We offer flexible pricing and prepare a custom offer for each project before we begin.
In addition, we have a clear partnership discount program for both new and returning clients designed to create long-term, mutually beneficial collaboration.

partnership.p1: Yes, we have an ongoing system of discounts, offers, and bonuses for both new and returning clients.

p2.after: — this allows you to explore our services and workflow without spending too much on your first project.

p3.before: For future collaborations, we offer a simple and transparent referral program: if you recommend our services to colleagues, friends or partners and it leads to a new project, both of you receive a
p3.after: on your next one. There are no limits and you can benefit from our partner program as often as you like.

partnership.p4: Additionally, every client receives exclusive free bonuses after project completion — materials that help you present your project even more effectively.

gallery.title: Gallery

All.label: All Projects
All.desc: A curated mix of our architectural work — exteriors, interiors, aerials and motion, shown side by side. Product, Virtual Staging and 360° Tours have their own sections.

Exterior.label: Exterior
Exterior.desc: Photorealistic architectural renderings showing buildings, structures, and landscaping in their real-world environments.

Interior.label: Interior
Interior.desc: Highly detailed internal designs capturing lighting, materials, and atmosphere to showcase living and commercial spaces.

Bird's-Eye View.label: Bird's-Eye View
Bird's-Eye View.desc: Aerial and drone-perspective renderings showing a development within its surrounding district and landscape.

Product.label: Product
Product.desc: Studio-quality 3D renderings of furniture and product pieces, lit and staged for catalogs and marketing.

Virtual Staging.label: Virtual Staging
Virtual Staging.desc: Real interior photographs digitally furnished and dressed to show a space's full potential.

360° Tours.label: 360° Tours
360° Tours.desc: Walkable 360° tours of a finished project — drag to look around, use the floorplan to move between scenes.

Animation.label: Animation
Animation.desc: Cinematic architectural films and motion showcases bringing a project to life through camera movement and mood.

Cinemagraph.label: Cinemagraph
Cinemagraph.desc: Static architectural visualizations enhanced with subtle loop animations, drawing instant attention to key design details.

Web.label: Web
Web.desc: Project sites, portfolios and landing pages built around the renders — shown as device mockups of three example sites.
